repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-feature
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin that exposes feature toggles as webex.internal.feature. It is a stateless facade over the device plugin's developer, user, and entitlement feature collections: promise-based reads, writes of user and developer toggles to the Feature service (single and bundled), handling of toggle records pushed by Mercury, and re-emission of device collection changes as change:developer, change:entitlement, and change:user events.

webex-feature-toggles.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing the package registers Feature as internal plugin 'feature' with the config object from src/config.js and re-exports Feature as the default export. The plugin API on webex.internal.feature is getFeature, setFeature, setBundledFeatures, and updateFeature. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md; the README states the plugin is internal and does not strictly follow semantic versioning.

feature-plugin-events.summary: Events triggered on webex.internal.feature: change:developer, change:entitlement, and change:user, each re-emitted from the matching change:internal.device.features.<keyType> event of the webex instance.

feature-toggle-service.source: Feature service (reached as service name 'feature' through the services catalog; route definitions are not in this repository)
feature-toggle-service.summary: setFeature POSTs {key, mutable: true, val} to features/users/<device.userId>/<keyType>; setBundledFeatures POSTs a list to features/users/<device.userId>/toggles and reads featureToggles from the response. webex-core converts the api option to a service name and resolves the host.

webex-device-registration.summary: Feature reads webex.internal.device.features.{developer,entitlement,user} and writes merged records into them; write URLs embed webex.internal.device.userId. The device plugin re-emits collection changes that Feature turns into change:<keyType> events.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Feature extends WebexPlugin, is registered with registerInternalPlugin, sends writes with this.request and the api option, and subscribes with listenToAndRun.

lodash.summary: Feature uses partition to split the bundled-write response into user and developer records.
